newsitem.title: USA: Life USA Q4 net slips on higher expenses.
newsitem.headline: Life USA Q4 net slips on higher expenses.

text.p: Life USA Holding Inc said on Monday earnings in the fourth quarter ended December 31 fell slightly as a result of higher operating expenses.

The company reported net income of $6.4 million, or $0.28 a share, in the period, compared to $6.6 million, or $0.30 a share one year ago. Total expenses were $71.8 million, up from $68.3 million in the corresponding quarter in 1995.
The financial services holding company said it is also preparing to market a line of mutual funds and may distribute variable life insurance and annuity contracts that could enhance its bottom line.
Life USA shares closed down 5/16 Monday to 10-13/16.
